nodes.description: UE has sent REGISTRATION REQUEST and is waiting for a response (Timer T3510 running).
UE has received REGISTRATION ACCEPT requiring acknowledgement and is preparing/sending REGISTRATION COMPLETE.
UE is successfully registered with the network (5GMM-REGISTERED state).
UE registration attempt was rejected by the network or failed due to maximum retries or other failures.
AMF is idle with respect to this UE's registration procedure.
AMF has received REGISTRATION REQUEST and is processing it (e.g., performing authentication, security).
AMF has sent REGISTRATION ACCEPT requiring acknowledgement and is waiting for REGISTRATION COMPLETE (Timer T3550 running).
AMF considers the UE successfully registered (5GMM-REGISTERED state).

edges.label: E_REGISTRATION_REQUEST

edges.description: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message not requiring REGISTRATION COMPLETE is sent by AMF / received by UE.

edges.label: E_REGISTRATION_ACCEPT_NoComplete
edges.description: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message not requiring REGISTRATION COMPLETE is sent by AMF / received by UE.

edges.description: REGISTRATION COMPLETE message is sent by UE / received by AMF.

edges.label: E_T3510_Timeout_Retry
edges.description: UE's T3510 timer expires before receiving a response, and retry counter is less than 5.

edges.label: E_T3510_Timeout_Max
edges.description: UE's T3510 timer expires, and retry counter reaches 5.

edges.label: E_T3550_Timeout_Retry
edges.description: AMF's T3550 timer expires (1st to 4th time) while waiting for REGISTRATION COMPLETE.

edges.label: E_T3550_Timeout_Max
edges.description: AMF's T3550 timer expires for the 5th time while waiting for REGISTRATION COMPLETE.

edges.label: E_Failure_AMF
edges.description: Abnormal case occurs at the AMF side (e.g., lower layer failure).
